title: Home practical guide and safety card: flour prints
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 46 (Home practical guide and safety card: flour prints (portal worksheet; on a tray, wash hands))
intro: Lesson 46: Pressure at home: footprints and flour. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see how area changes pressure
equipment: A tray of flour 3 cm deep
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Press the tin on its base with the 2 kg on top
Measure the depth of the print
Flatten again; press the tin on its rim with the same load
Explain: smaller area, bigger pressure; wash hands

questions.q: Big question: which tin sinks further in sand?
questions.a: The one on its rim: smaller area, higher pressure.
